verdict.rationale: Proa ships an official, installable CLI (`cargo install proa-cli`). It covers scaffolding (`proa new site ... --yes`, which is non-interactive and agent-friendly), component vendoring (`proa ui add button`), route inspection (`proa site routes`), a dev server with reload, and formatting checks (`proa fmt --check --verify`). It also scaffolds an AGENTS.md file by default, which ties the CLI directly to AI-agent workflows. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, evidence of machine-readable (e.g. JSON) output for agent consumption.
